# Glovo

- Group / owner: Delivery Hero
- Homepage: https://glovoapp.com/en (uses the saved address).
- Search: URL query parameters do NOT work reliably. Open the homepage, click the search box, type the name, press Enter. (Verified 2026-11-01, RO.)
- Store URL pattern: `https://glovoapp.com/en/<country-iso2>/<city>/stores/<slug>` (e.g. `/en/ro/bucharest/...`).
- Login signals: user's first name top-right = logged in; "Log in" = logged out.
- Store header: promo badge (e.g. "-30% select items"), delivery fee (struck through if free), "Schedule for Tomorrow" when closed. Discounted items show the discounted price first, original second.
- Cart / checkout: "Your order" panel on the store page; fees after continuing to the checkout summary. (To verify.)
- Subscription: Glovo Prime.
- Status: verified (RO, 2026-11-01) for search and store page.
